profile.name: Nishant Parmar
profile.tagline: I build web apps, Android and mobile apps, and data dashboards.
profile.specialization: Full Stack · Android · React Native · Data Analysis
profile.bio: I am a Computer Science student at Parul University, graduating in 2027. I build web and Android apps, and I work with data using Python and pandas. During a remote internship at Bluestock Fintech, I cleaned financial statements, calculated company ratios and built dashboards. I am looking for Full Stack Developer and Data Analyst roles.

services.title: Full Stack Web Development
services.description: Web applications built with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Flask and MongoDB, with REST APIs.

services.title: Android App Development
services.description: Offline-first Android apps in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and Room.

services.title: Mobile Apps
services.description: Cross-platform screens and interfaces built with React Native and Expo.

services.title: Data Analysis and Dashboards
services.description: Data cleaning, ratio analysis and interactive dashboards using Python, pandas and Chart.js.

experience.summary: A remote internship focused on financial data and dashboards.
highlights: Cleaned and standardized balance sheet, profit and loss, and cash flow data using Python and pandas. Calculated debt-to-equity, net profit margin, interest coverage and free cash flow.
Built a company health scoring model and Chart.js dashboards (sector treemap, screener, risk and return map) for Nifty-100-style companies, checked with automated tests.
Built REST API endpoints for village search and autocomplete across state, district and sub-district levels, secured with API keys. Deployed the projects on Vercel.

experience.summary: Learning and building mobile screens with React Native and Expo.
highlights: Building frontend screens with React Native (Expo), focusing on UI and UX.
Taught myself React Native over the past 3 months.

projects.title: SpendWise
projects.subtitle: Expense Tracker and Analytics App (Android)
projects.description: An offline-first Android app for recording income and expenses. All data is stored on the device with Room. The analytics dashboard shows savings rate, spending by category, monthly trends, month-over-month comparison and budget alerts. Users can export CSV files for analysis in Excel or Python.

projects.title: ResumeIQ
projects.subtitle: Resume Tracker and Editor
projects.description: A browser app that scores PDF and DOCX resumes from 0 to 100 against a documented rubric. AI suggestions are approved one at a time. An application tracker stores resume versions and shows an analytics dashboard.

projects.title: B100 Intelligence
projects.subtitle: Fundamental Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: An interactive dashboard for Nifty-100-style companies, built with synthetic data. It includes a sector treemap, a screener, a risk and return map and a 100-point company health score. A mock location REST API is included as a demo.

projects.title: Fresh-mart
projects.subtitle: Smart Store Locator and Inventory
projects.description: A grocery web app for product search, with stock status and aisle locations. The admin panel manages inventory and sends low-stock alerts. Customers have accounts with hashed passwords and order history.
